frequency_question: How often do proposed financial/banking service tax clarifications receive formal approval within a comparable window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal agenda items concerning financial, banking, or NBFC tax rate adjustments or exemptions brought before the indirect tax council; excludes general annual rate rationalizations not specific to financial intermediation services.

cases.name: GST rate adjustment on outsourced financial services
GST exemption review on certain banking guarantees
Clarification on digital payment gateway merchant discount rates
Special tax treatment for priority sector lending certificates
Clarification on recovery agent services provided to banks

coverage_note: 7 named cases identified from major regulatory council meeting cycles over recent years; believed to represent the comprehensive set of comparable financial service tax classification proposals.
known_gaps: Minor state-level ad-hoc exemptions not brought to the central council are excluded by definition.
validity_reason: Tax council decision-making structures and procedural timelines remain stable over multi-year horizons.
